recent_event_impact: 8/7 July NFP +23K vs +83K expected (May+Jun revised -103K) → Sept hike odds tumbled from ~55% to ~44%, hold jumped from 45% to 60%. 8/12 July CPI +0.1% MoM / 3.4% YoY (down from 3.5%) — modest cooling failed to fully reverse hike bias, hold settled at 50.3% and hike_25 rebuilt to ~45%.
commentary: Market is essentially coin-flipping Sept 16 between a hold (50%) and a 25bp HIKE (45%) — cut probabilities are minimal. This is a hawkish regime: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% for 5 straight meetings with 3 hawkish dissenters in July wanting a hike; weak July NFP briefly cooled hike bets but sticky 3.4% CPI kept the hike scenario alive. Implied path shows ~50-60% cumulative probability of at least one hike by year-end 2026, with terminal centered at 3.75-4.00% by Q1 2027. Out-meeting (Oct/Dec/Jan) probabilities are estimated from implied path direction, not directly observed on CME snapshot.
